questions.query: How do I make a URL route accept POST instead of only GET?

evidence.quote: You can use the ``methods`` argument of the :meth:`~flask.Flask.route` decorator to handle different HTTP methods.

questions.query: Where should I put static CSS files and how can I build their URLs?

evidence.quote: To generate URLs for static files, use the special ``'static'`` endpoint name

questions.query: What happens when the slash at the end of a projects URL is omitted?

evidence.quote: If you access the URL without a trailing slash (``/projects``), Flask redirects you to the canonical URL with the trailing slash (``/projects/``).

questions.query: Why do templates escape user-provided HTML?

evidence.quote: user-provided values rendered in the output must be escaped to protect from injection attacks.

questions.query: How can I keep existing sessions working while rotating secret signing keys?

evidence.quote: This allows a project to implement key rotation without invalidating active sessions or other recently-signed secrets.

questions.query: What happens to exceptions when TESTING is enabled?

evidence.quote: Enable testing mode. Exceptions are propagated rather than handled by the the app's error handlers.

questions.query: Which cookie setting prevents access from JavaScript?

evidence.quote: Browsers will not allow JavaScript access to cookies marked as "HTTP only" for security.

questions.query: When configuring logging should I create the application object first?

evidence.quote: If possible, configure logging before creating the application object.

questions.query: How can I remove the default app.logger handler?
What stream receives default logs when no request is active?

evidence.quote: Outside a request, it will log to :data:`sys.stderr`.

questions.query: Do test client requests require a running live server?

evidence.quote: The test client makes requests to the application without running a live server.

questions.query: How do I follow redirect responses in a test request?

evidence.quote: By passing ``follow_redirects=True`` to a request method, the client will continue to make requests until a non-redirect response is returned.

questions.query: Does test_request_context call before_request functions automatically?

evidence.quote: Creating a test request context doesn't run any of the Flask dispatching code, so ``before_request`` functions are not called.

questions.query: How is an error handler chosen when both code and exception class match?

evidence.quote: When Flask catches an exception while handling a request, it is first looked up by code.

questions.query: Can a blueprint error handler catch a routing 404?

evidence.quote: the blueprint cannot handle 404 routing errors because the 404 occurs at the routing level before the blueprint can be determined.

questions.query: Is the development server safe for production deployment?

evidence.quote: Do not use the development server when deploying to production.

questions.query: What does a reverse proxy mean in front of a WSGI server?

evidence.quote: Putting an HTTP server in front of the WSGI server is called a "reverse proxy."
